decisions.reason: The product builds on established glass flake spraying capabilities and is still mentioned on the website, so under behavioral theory its results likely fall within an acceptable range given slack and recent launch.
Its dedicated webpage and close fit with the firm's core pump offerings suggest results meet or exceed aspirations, making a drop very unlikely.
As a product line with several models and favorable launch language referencing proven components, it appears to meet aspirations and warrants continued support.

The dedicated page indicates active commitment, and although it is an adjacent monitoring product, the firm's slack and past performance in related systems support carrying it while market acceptance is still uncertain.
Launched only in 2024, it is too early to compare reliably against aspirations, and the firm's slack favors keeping this close-to-core spraying system on the market.
